question: What is the tone of the speaker?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Contemptuous.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Dogmatic"** means asserting opinions in an authoritative or arrogant manner. (कट्टरपंथी)

 
 
• **Example:** The professor's dogmatic approach to teaching left no room for student input or discussion.
 
 
 
• **"Contemptuous"** refers to showing or expressing disdain or scorn. (तिरस्कारपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example:** She gave him a contemptuous look, clearly unimpressed by his attempts to apologize.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Contemptuous.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dogmatic** (कट्टरपंथी): Asserting opinions in an authoritative or arrogant manner.

 
 
• **Example:** The professor's dogmatic approach to teaching left no room for student input or discussion.
 
 
 
• **Apologetic** (क्षमाप्रार्थी): Expressing or showing regret or remorse.
 
 
• **Example:** He was very apologetic about the mistake he made in the report.
 
 
 
• **Cynical** (निंदक): Believing that people are motivated by self-interest; distrustful of human sincerity or integrity.
 
 
• **Example:** Her cynical attitude made it hard for her to trust anyone.
